text: Note: detailed guidance parameter selection, please refer xcms documentation ?CentWaveParam help page.

title: 1. Preprocessing raw files with xcms
code: obi <- ObiwarpParam(binSize = 0.5)

title: 1. Preprocessing raw files with xcms
text: runxcmsFT() runs five steps returns named list. Retrieve xcms_outputs:
code: xcms_out <- runxcmsFT(   files_dir    = system.file("extdata", "mix84_data", package = "MS1Match"),    cwp          = cwp,   pdp          = pdp,   obi          = obi,   sample_name  = c("3ul"),   sample_group = c("3ul"),   BPPARAM      = SnowParam(workers = 4)    ) xcms_output_result <- xcms_out$result     # list(x_exp, pd) xcms_output_cp     <- xcms_out$cp         # all detected chromPeaks xcms_output_cpft   <- xcms_out$cp_linked  # chromPeaks with feature_id xcms_output_ft     <- xcms_out$ft         # final processed feature table

title: 2a. MS1Match workflow: StM14 (MS1 + MS2)
text: tutorial walks full MS1Match workflow StM14 dataset: 14 standard compounds spiked Pseudomonas aeruginosa metabolome extract, measured MS1 MS2. covers: Peak picking xcms (feature table + MsExperiment object); see vignette 01_preprocessing_xcms Building per-feature consensus MS2 spectra Importing reference library preparing adduct/neutral-loss tables Running MS1Match pipeline: direct library match → Phase 1 Phase 2 annotation → ISF (-source fragment) annotation → joined tier assignment Summarizing annotation tiers (table + plot) Exporting results (CSV, XLSX, figures) anno_result built input vignette 3. Evaluate feature-grouping tool MS1Match. Package objects take long time (re)compute (peak picking, MS2 consensus building) loaded cached .rds files bundled package time efficiency.
code: library(MS1Match) library(xcms) library(MsExperiment) library(BiocParallel) library(S4Vectors) library(Spectra) library(MsBackendMgf) library(dplyr)

title: 2a. MS1Match workflow: StM14 (MS1 + MS2)
text: runxcmsFT() wrapper around standard xcms workflow. takes raw file paths plus three standard xcms parameter objects (CentWaveParam, PeakDensityParam, ObiwarpParam) returns list aligned feature table (ft) underlying MsExperiment object (x_exp). tutorial load precomputed run document knits without access raw files. processFeatureTable() applies retention-time window (60–1200 s) drop features outside analytically useful range — void volume column wash-.

title: 2a. MS1Match workflow: StM14 (MS1 + MS2)
text: Building per-feature consensus MS2 spectra three-step process: extract candidate MS2 scans feature (get_ms2_peaks(), wrapper around xcms::chromPeakSpectra()), collapse repeated scans feature one consensus spectrum (combineSpectra()), convert result named list format annotator expects (read_ms2_consensus()). tutorial just load cached result.
code: # Not run — kept for reference. # Requires access to the XcmsExperiment object from last step # Step 1 — get MS2 peaks with feature_name ms2_peaks <- get_ms2_peaks(StM14_x_exp, expand_rt = 20, expand_mz = 0.02)   # Step 2 — build consensus ms2_consensus <- combineSpectra(   ms2_peaks,   FUN          = combinePeaksData,   ppm          = 20,   peaks        = "intersect",   minProp      = 0.50,   intensityFun = median,   mzFun        = median,   f            = factor(ms2_peaks$feature_name) )  ms2_list <- read_ms2_consensus(ms2_consensus, feature_table = StM14_FT_sub) # Not run by default — requires the raw MSMS files and the XcmsExperiment object from last step  # Step 1: rerun get_ms2_peaks  ms2_peaks <- suppressWarnings(   get_ms2_peaks(StM14_x_exp, expand_rt = 10, expand_mz = 0.02) ) # Step 2: combine per-feature consensus ms2_consensus <- combineSpectra(   ms2_peaks,   f            = ms2_peaks$feature_name,   method       = combinePeaks,   minProp      = 0.5,   intensityFun = base::mean,   mzFun        = base::mean,   ppm          = 10 )  # Step 3: convert to named list ms2_list <- read_ms2_consensus(ms2_consensus, feature_table = StM14_FT_sub)   #saveRDS(ms2_consensus,"StM14_ms2_consensus.rds") ms2_consensus <- readRDS(system.file("extdata", "RDS_files", "StM14", "StM14_ms2_consensus.rds", package = "MS1Match")) ms2_list <- read_ms2_consensus(ms2_consensus, feature_table = StM14_FT_sub)

what: 4. MS1Match Pipeline: library match and annotation
title: 2a. MS1Match workflow: StM14 (MS1 + MS2)
text: core MS1Match pipeline, run four steps: createDirectLibMatch() + libAnnotate() — match features library reference within retention-time ppm window, scored cosine similarity mirror plots. createPeakAnnotationFromLibraryMatch() + annotateLibMatch() — annotate features library matches, resolving adducts neutral losses assign Phase 1 tiers (Tier 1a–Tier 2), optional Phase 2 expansion (Tier 1a_exp–Tier 1d_exp) lower-confidence, [M+H]⁺-relative matches. cutoff_MH applies tiers. createPeakAnnotationISF() + annotateISF() — attribute -source fragments confirmed parent (Tier 1a anchor) using MS2 consensus spectra, within ppm_isf/rt_isf_threshold tolerances. join_annotation_results() — merge everything one tier-resolved, cross-compound-aware annotation table.
code: DirectLibMatch_MS1_StM14_obj <- createDirectLibMatch(   FT = StM14_FT_sub,   compounds_list = Si14_library,   rt_thr_compound = 30,   rt_thr_coelution = 5,    ppm = 10,   ms_level = "MS1",   polarity = "pos" )  direct_match_StM14_MS1_obj <- libAnnotate(   DirectLibMatch_MS1_StM14_obj,   compute_cosine = TRUE,   ppm = 20,   BPPARAM = SerialParam() )  # Accessing MS1 Matching Results  direct_match_StM14_res_MS1 <- results(direct_match_StM14_MS1_obj)  # ──  Create annotation object ─────────────────────────────────────────────── PeakAnnotation_obj_MS1 <- createPeakAnnotationFromLibraryMatch(   library_matches    = direct_match_StM14_res_MS1,   adducts_df         = adduct_table,   neutral_loss_table = neutral_loss_table,   FT            = StM14_FT_sub,   polarity           = "positive",   ppm                = 30 )  # ──  Run lib-match annotation (Phase 1 + optional Phase 2 expansion) ──────── StM14_annotate_res_ms1 <- annotateLibMatch(   PeakAnnotation_obj_MS1,   cutoff_MH = TRUE )  # ── Create ISF annotation object ──────────────────────────────────────────  PeakAnnotation_ISF_obj <- createPeakAnnotationISF(   phase1_result    = StM14_annotate_res_ms1,   ms2_list         = ms2_list,   FT          = StM14_FT_sub,   parent_col       = "PI_match",   ppm_isf          = 10,   rt_isf_threshold = 5.0 )  # ── Run ISF / MS2 fragment annotation ───────────────────────────────────── isf_result <- annotateISF(PeakAnnotation_ISF_obj)  # ──  Join outputs ─────── anno_result <- join_annotation_results(   FT              = StM14_FT_sub,   direct_lib_list = direct_match_StM14_res_MS1,   lib_anno_list   = StM14_annotate_res_ms1,   isf_result      = isf_result,   include_phase2  = TRUE )

title: 2b. MS1Match workflow: SuperPool (MS1 + MS2)
text: tutorial walks full MS1Match workflow SuperPool dataset, pooled sample MSMLS standards, measured MS1 MS2. follows steps vignette 2a larger compound set. covers: Peak picking xcms (feature table + MsExperiment object); see vignette 1. Preprocessing raw files xcms Building per-feature consensus MS2 spectra Importing reference library preparing adduct/neutral-loss tables Running MS1Match pipeline: direct library match → Phase 1 Phase 2 annotation → ISF (-source fragment) annotation → joined tier assignment Summarizing annotation tiers (table + plot) Exporting results (CSV, figures) Package objects take long time (re)compute (peak picking, MS2 consensus building) loaded cached .rds files time efficiency. corresponding “scratch” code kept, can re-run new dataset pointing files_dir raw files.
code: library(xcms) library(MsExperiment) library(BiocParallel) library(S4Vectors) library(Spectra) library(MsBackendMgf) library(dplyr) library(MS1Match)

title: 2b. MS1Match workflow: SuperPool (MS1 + MS2)
text: runxcmsFT() wrapper around standard xcms workflow. takes raw file paths plus three standard xcms parameter objects (CentWaveParam, PeakDensityParam, ObiwarpParam) returns list aligned feature table (ft) underlying MsExperiment object (x_exp). tutorial load precomputed run without access raw files, apply retention-time window (60–1200 s) drop features outside analytically useful range.

title: 2b. MS1Match workflow: SuperPool (MS1 + MS2)
text: Building per-feature consensus MS2 spectra three-step process: extract candidate MS2 scans feature (get_ms2_peaks(), wrapper around xcms::chromPeakSpectra()), collapse repeated scans feature one consensus spectrum (combineSpectra()), convert result named list format annotator expects (read_ms2_consensus()). tutorial just load cached result.
code: # Not run by default — requires the raw MSMS files and the XcmsExperiment # object from the previous step.  # Step 2a — extract MS2 peaks with feature_name assignment ms2_peaks <- get_ms2_peaks(x_exp, expand_rt = 10, expand_mz = 0.02)  # Step 2b — build one consensus spectrum per feature ms2_consensus <- combineSpectra(   ms2_peaks,   FUN          = combinePeaksData,   ppm          = 20,   peaks        = "intersect",   minProp      = 0.50,   intensityFun = median,   mzFun        = median,   f            = factor(ms2_peaks$feature_name) )  # saveRDS(ms2_consensus, "ms2_consensus_SuperPool.rds") ms2_consensus <- readRDS(system.file("extdata", "RDS_files", "SuperPool", "ms2_consensus_SuperPool.rds", package = "MS1Match")) ms2_list <- read_ms2_consensus(ms2_consensus, feature_table = pool_FT_sub)

title: 2b. MS1Match workflow: SuperPool (MS1 + MS2)
text: Alongside MS2 list load two tables — adduct table (covering 4M multimers) neutral-loss table — plus -house CBIO library, restricted compounds targeted pool.
code: # ── Adduct / neutral loss tables  ──────────────────────────────── adduct_table <- read.csv(   system.file("extdata", "Adducts", "adducts_with_4M.csv", package = "MS1Match") )  neutral_loss_table <- read.csv(   system.file("extdata", "Neutral loss", "neutral loss database.csv", package = "MS1Match"),   check.names = TRUE )  # ── In-house library, restricted to compounds targeted in this pool ── CBIO_library <- import_msp(   file_path = system.file(     "extdata", "CBIO", "CBIO_Standards.msp",     package = "MS1Match"   ),   ionPolarity   = "pos",   spectrum_type = "MS1",   filter        = list(field = "Comments", pattern = "MSMLS"),   dedup_by      = "name_only" ) ## [parser] Parsed:          1811 ## [parser] Filtered:        1309 ## [parser] Pre-dedup total: 502 ## [parser] Duplicates:      6 ## [parser] Building result: 496 compounds... ## [parser] Done. length(CBIO_library) ## [1] 400 CBIO_target <- read.csv(system.file(   "extdata", "mixture_pool", "Pool_traget_list", "Pool_traget_list.csv",   package = "MS1Match" ))  CBIO_library_target <- CBIO_library[   which(sapply(CBIO_library, function(x) x$Name) %in% CBIO_target$CNAME_CBIO) ]

what: 4. MS1Match Pipeline: library match and annotation
title: 2b. MS1Match workflow: SuperPool (MS1 + MS2)
text: core MS1Match pipeline, run four steps: createDirectLibMatch() + libAnnotate() — match features library reference within retention-time ppm window, scored cosine similarity mirror plots. createPeakAnnotationFromLibraryMatch() + annotateLibMatch() — annotate features library matches, resolving adducts neutral losses assign Phase 1 tiers (Tier 1a–Tier 2), optional Phase 2 expansion lower-confidence, [M+H]⁺-relative matches. cutoff_MH applies tiers. createPeakAnnotationISF() + annotateISF() — attribute -source fragments confirmed parent (Tier 1a anchor) using MS2 consensus spectra, within ppm_isf/rt_isf_threshold tolerances. join_annotation_results() — merge everything one tier-resolved, cross-compound-aware annotation table. Vignette 3 starts anno_result like one. package ships copy extdata/RDS_files/SuperPool/anno_result_SuperPool.rds; data, save :
code: DirectLibMatch_MS1_pool_obj <- createDirectLibMatch(   FT = pool_FT_sub,   compounds_list = CBIO_library_target,   rt_thr_compound = 120,   rt_thr_coelution = 5,   ppm = 10,   ms_level = "MS1",   polarity = "pos" )  direct_match_pool_MS1_obj <- libAnnotate(   DirectLibMatch_MS1_pool_obj,   compute_cosine = TRUE,   ppm = 20,   BPPARAM = SerialParam() )  # Accessing MS1 Matching Results direct_match_pool_res_MS1 <- results(direct_match_pool_MS1_obj)  # ──  Create annotation object ─────────────────────────────────────────────── PeakAnnotation_obj_MS1 <- createPeakAnnotationFromLibraryMatch(   library_matches    = direct_match_pool_res_MS1,   adducts_df         = adduct_table,   neutral_loss_table = neutral_loss_table,   FT                 = pool_FT_sub,   polarity           = "positive",   ppm                = 30 )  # ──  Run lib-match annotation (Phase 1 + optional Phase 2 expansion) ──────── pool_annotate_res_ms1 <- annotateLibMatch(   PeakAnnotation_obj_MS1,   cutoff_MH = TRUE )  # ── Create ISF annotation object ────────────────────────────────────────── PeakAnnotation_ISF_obj <- createPeakAnnotationISF(   phase1_result    = pool_annotate_res_ms1,   ms2_list         = ms2_list,   FT               = pool_FT_sub,   ppm_isf          = 10,   rt_isf_threshold = 30.0 )  # ── Run ISF / MS2 fragment annotation ───────────────────────────────────── isf_result <- annotateISF(PeakAnnotation_ISF_obj)  # ──  Join: resolves tiers─────── anno_result <- join_annotation_results(   FT              = pool_FT_sub,   direct_lib_list = direct_match_pool_res_MS1,   lib_anno_list   = pool_annotate_res_ms1,   isf_result      = isf_result,   include_phase2  = TRUE ) saveRDS(anno_result, "anno_result_SuperPool.rds")

levels = stack_levels)   x_pos_chr <- as.character(dat$plot_tier)   x_pos_chr[grepl("^Tier2", x_pos_chr)] <- "Tier2"   dat$x_pos <- factor(x_pos_chr, levels = x_levels)   overall <- as.data.frame(     table(x_pos = dat$x_pos, plot_tier = dat$plot_tier),     stringsAsFactors = FALSE   )   overall$x_pos     <- factor(overall$x_pos,     levels = all_xlevels)   overall$plot_tier <- title: 2c. MS1Match with other inputs: MZmine, CSV, no MS2
text: example StM14 processed MZmine: 9 MS1 files (4, 8 10 µM, three replicates ), exported MZmine’s full feature table CSV. full export needed, filtered one (e.g. “rows ion identity”). MS1Match see every feature, vignette 3 can evaluate grouping features table. read_mzmine_feature_table() converts MZmine export layout MS1Match functions expect: MZmine id becomes feature_name (1 → FT0001); mz becomes mzmed, rt converted minutes seconds rtmed; per-file datafile:<file>:area columns become sample intensities, plus intensity_mean intensity_median; features found fewer min_detect_fraction samples dropped (default 0.5, .e. least 5 9 files ). MZmine’s groupings (feature_group, ion_identities:iin_id) part ft. Section 5 reads CSV. MZmine features example elute 62 1197 s, extra RT window needed. data, apply 60–1200 s window vignette 2a running MS1Match.

text: One row per reference feature × compound (: features MS1Match assigned 14 StM14 standards), : MS1Match evidence: tier annotation; per tool: feature’s group, anchor’s group reference status (NA group = tool group feature); CAMERA also isotope adduct labels. statuses taken evals (Step 4), match benchmark. code: # MS1Match evidence per reference row evidence <- anno_result$export_feature_compound_summary %>%   select(feature_name, Compound_name, Lib_group, reference_tier,          any_of(c("grp_anno_match", "exp_anno_match", "iso_annotation"))) %>%   mutate(MS1Match_anno = coalesce(na_if(grp_anno_match, ""),                                   na_if(exp_anno_match, ""))) %>%   select(-any_of(c("grp_anno_match", "exp_anno_match")))  # group, anchor group and status per tool, prefixed with the tool name tool_cols <- function(tool) {   evals[[tool]]$full_table %>%     filter(!is.na(Compound_name)) %>%     select(feature_name, Compound_name, Lib_group,            !!paste0(tool, "_group")        := group,            !!paste0(tool, "_anchor_group") := anchor_group,            !!paste0(tool, "_ref_status")   := ref_status) }  feature_overview <- Reduce(   function(acc, tool) left_join(acc, tool_cols(tool),                                 by = c("feature_name", "Compound_name", "Lib_group")),   names(evals),   evidence %>% filter(feature_name %in% evals[[1]]$full_table$feature_name) )  # CAMERA's own labels camera_labels <- CAMERA_peaklist %>%   select(feature_name, any_of(c("isotopes", "adduct"))) %>%   rename_with(~ paste0("CAMERA_", .x), -feature_name) %>%   mutate(across(-feature_name, ~ na_if(trimws(as.character(.x)), "")))  feature_overview <- feature_overview %>%   left_join(feature_table %>% select(feature_name, mzmed, rtmed), by = "feature_name") %>%   left_join(camera_labels, by = "feature_name") %>%   relocate(Compound_name, feature_name, mzmed, rtmed, reference_tier,            MS1Match_anno, any_of("iso_annotation")) %>%   arrange(Compound_name, rtmed, mzmed)  feature_overview ## # A tibble: 686 × 16 ##    Compound_name         feature_name mzmed rtmed reference_tier   MS1Match_anno ##    <chr>                 <chr>        <dbl> <dbl> <chr>            <chr>         ##  1 2-Methoxybenzoic acid FT2309        496.  507. Tier1b_exp_Isot… NA            ##  6 2-Methoxybenzoic acid FT0322        138.  507. Tier1b_exp_Isot… NA            ##  7 2-Methoxybenzoic acid FT0297        135.  507. Tier2_Unexplain… NA            ##  8 2-Methoxybenzoic acid FT0451        153.  507. Tier1a_AnnoMatch [M+H]+ 152.0… ##  9 2-Methoxybenzoic acid FT0461        154.  507. Tier1b_Isotope   NA            ## 10 2-Methoxybenzoic acid FT0963        249.  507. Tier2_Unexplain… NA            ## # ℹ 676 more rows ## # ℹ 10 more variables: iso_annotation <chr>, Lib_group <chr>, ## #   CAMERA_group <chr>, CAMERA_anchor_group <chr>, CAMERA_ref_status <chr>, ## #   RAMClustR_group <chr>, RAMClustR_anchor_group <chr>, ## #   RAMClustR_ref_status <chr>, CAMERA_isotopes <chr>, CAMERA_adduct <chr> status_summary <- function(tool) {   st <- feature_overview[[paste0(tool, "_ref_status")]]   feature_overview %>%     mutate(.st = st) %>%     group_by(Compound_name) %>%     summarise(       !!paste0(tool, "_confirmed")   := sum(.st == "Ref-confirmed",   na.rm = TRUE),       !!paste0(tool, "_conflicting") := sum(.st == "Ref-conflicting", na.rm = TRUE),       !!paste0(tool, "_unassigned")  := sum(.st %in% c("Ref-unassigned",                                                         "Ref-unassigned (no-anchor)")),       .groups = "drop") }  per_standard <- Reduce(   function(acc, tool) left_join(acc, status_summary(tool), by = "Compound_name"),   names(evals),   feature_overview %>% count(Compound_name, name = "n_features") ) %>%   arrange(desc(n_features))  show_table(per_standard,            caption = "Reference features per standard and their status per tool",            scroll = TRUE) write.csv(feature_overview, "StM14_feature_overview.csv", row.names = FALSE, na = "") write.csv(per_standard,     "StM14_per_standard.csv",     row.names = FALSE)

text: MS1Match R package library-guided, compound-centric grouping annotation redundant LC-MS features. uses full-range MS1 MS2 reference libraries assign adducts, multimers, isotopes, neutral losses -source fragments compounds originate . Main functions: Preprocessing (optional): feature detection raw data xcms framework, import feature tables MZmine CSV files Library matching: direct matching detected features MS1 MS2 reference spectra Feature annotation evidence tiers: ion type, isotopologue, MS2 fragment neutral-loss evidence (Tiers 1a 1d), plus matched unexplained features (Tier 2) M-expansion: extension compound group co-eluting features without direct library match (expansion tiers) Evaluation grouping tools: reference-relative comparison feature grouping tools (e.g., CAMERA, RAMClustR) compound-centric MS1Match groups

title: Create a PeakAnnotationFromLibraryMatch object — createPeakAnnotationFromLibraryMatch
text: User-facing constructor PeakAnnotationFromLibraryMatch-class. Bundles spectral library match results, full feature pool, annotation parameters single object ready annotate(). Annotation runs two phases: Phase 1 — within library-match group: adduct match (Tier 1a), isotope lookup (Tier 1b), pairwise neutral loss (Tier 1c), precursor/MS2 match (Tier 1d), unexplained (Tier 2).  Isotope labels computed union library features full pool per-group work. Phase 2 — M-expansion: confirmed neutral mass M Phase 1, pool features yet annotated scanned within rt_exp_threshold seconds ppm_exp ppm (Tier 1a_exp, 1b_exp, 1c_exp).  Skipped FT supplied. RT used automatically present; RT values NA RT gate fire — separate -RT / without-RT paths needed.

Accepts either: single named list elements field pattern — drops entries whose field contain pattern: list named lists multiple conditions (logic — conditions must satisfied): Match case-sensitive fixed. dedup_by Deduplication grouping key: "name_adduct_mode_energy" (default) One entry per Name + Adduct + IonMode + CollisionEnergy. Preserves fragmentation diversity across energies — recommended MoNA MS2. "name_adduct_mode" One entry per Name + Adduct + IonMode. Recommended small -house libraries. require_formula Logical. TRUE, entries missing invalid formula ("unk", empty) discarded parsing. Default FALSE. Set TRUE exact mass required downstream matching annotation — example, CSU-PMF MS1 libraries entries without formula used. reserve_n Memory hint: expected number compounds (default 60000). Increase large files reduce internal reallocations. max_records Integer. Stop many records (-1 = limit).

what: Join lists of annotation results to library match output — join_annotation_results
title: Join lists of annotation results to library match output — join_annotation_results
text: Combine direct library match results (MS1/MS2) downstream annotation results (adduct/isotope/MS2 fragment/NL) onto feature table. Tier naming convention: 1a — adduct match (Phase 1, within library group) 1b — isotope (Phase 1, within library group) 1c — MS2 fragment match (Phase 1: feature already Phase 1 library group) 1d — neutral loss (Phase 1, pairwise within group) 1a_exp / 1b_exp / 1c_exp / 1d_exp — Phase 2 expansions (feature assigned Phase 1; derived Phase 1 confirmed M) 2 — unexplained (group, rule fires) Tiers mutually exclusive — one tier per feature, highest priority wins: 1a > 1b > 1c > 1d > 2 > 1a_exp > 1b_exp > 1c_exp > 1d_exp. Tier2 (Unexplained) Phase 1 assignment therefore outranks Phase 2 expansions. annotation_phase column takes exactly two values: "Phase1" (Tier 1a/1b/1c/1d Tier 2 assignment) "Phase2" (_exp tier).  Sub-labels Phase1_MS2frag Phase2_IsoExpansion used; reference_tier already encodes specific evidence type.
